answer: If a sybil farm slips past every filter, the community can still fork it out. Under intersubjective forking, any holder may open a challenge naming a suspected clone cluster; if most honest participants agree, the ledger splits, and the fork that wallets, exchanges and graders follow simply omits that cluster's balances. Picture 400 clones grazing one meadow of rewards: after a week-long voyage of public evidence, the community adopts the fork and their hoard becomes a counterfeit pearl no market will buy. Knowing this, farming stops paying.
